label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.2 a.3…: There is no infinite regress among NECESSARY_1 beings…
locator: I q.2 a.3 co., tertia via: Non est autem possibile quod procedatur in infinitum in necessariis quae habent causam suae necessitatis, sicut nec in causis efficientibus, ut probatum est
interpretation: Well-foundedness of 'is caused in its necessity by another necessary being', restricted to necessary beings. 'Sicut nec in causis efficientibus, ut probatum est' grounds it by analogy with the secunda via's no-regress premise; that link is not formalized here.
